display.purpose: Centered serif statements opening every page; weight 500, never bold.

quote.purpose: Source Serif 4 italic, one per article, thin blue left rule.

components.name: Pill Button
components.description: The signature action: light blue pill, uppercase, arrow slides on hover.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; background: #bcd2ff; color: #0b2161; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; font-family: Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 999px; transition: background-color 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill:hover { background: #a7c3ff; } .ds-pill .ds-arrow { transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-pill:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1e40c9; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary pill; fills with ink on hover.
components.css: .ds-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; background: transparent; color: #1a1a1a; border: 1px solid #1a1a1a; padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; font-family: Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 999px; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-outline:hover { background: #1a1a1a; color: #fff; }

components.name: Editorial Card
components.description: Rounded card with gradient or photo cover and sans body; lifts on hover.
components.html: StrategyAI readiness is an owner decisionTey Jian Han · July 2026
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 300px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #d8d8d6; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; font-family: Archivo, Arial, sans-serif; transition: box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(26,26,26,0.12); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-card-cover { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; padding: 0.9rem; aspect-ratio: 16/10; background: radial-gradient(60% 80% at 80% 20%, rgba(255,179,92,0.45), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(70% 90% at 20% 80%, #4f7df0, transparent 70%), linear-gradient(135deg, #0b2161, #1230a0); } .ds-card-tag { background: #fff; color: #1a1a1a; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; } .ds-card-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 1.4rem; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; color: #1a1a1a; } .ds-card-meta { font-size: 0.8125rem; color: #4d4d4d; }

components.name: Gradient Art
components.description: The signature surface: deep blue field with one amber and one red Malaysian glint. Never flags or flowers.
components.css: .ds-art { display: block; width: 320px; aspect-ratio: 16/9; border-radius: 24px; background: radial-gradient(52% 68% at 82% 18%, rgba(255,179,92,0.45), transparent 62%), radial-gradient(44% 60% at 12% 88%, rgba(226,59,59,0.4), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(70% 90% at 28% 22%, #7fa4ff, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(80% 100% at 78% 78%, #4f7df0, transparent 72%), linear-gradient(135deg, #0b2161 0%, #1230a0 55%, #0b2161 100%); }

narrative.overview: Blueprint AI Training carries itself the way today's bcg.com does, a reference the user pinned with screenshots: a calm white ground on which everything interesting happens inside inset, rounded panels. Serif display type gives statements their authority; Archivo does the working text; actions are uppercase pill buttons with a sliding arrow. Malaysia is present but never literal: the national colors live inside the gradient art as soft glints of red and amber inside deep blue fields.
keyCharacteristics: White page ground; all color arrives inside rounded inset panels and cards
Serif display over sans working text, the consulting-firm pairing
Pill buttons, uppercase with arrows; chips for facts and filters
Gradient art carries the Malaysian palette as glints, never as flat national color
The insights mosaic: one tall photo card, one gradient card, one dark view-all card
Footer in two layers: light paper columns over a deep blue bar

rules.name: The Inset Rule
rules.body: Color never runs edge to edge. Every colored surface is a rounded panel or card floating inside the container; the only full-width surfaces are the header and the footer layers.

rules.name: The Glint Rule
rules.body: Malaysian red and amber exist only inside gradients, as radial glints in a blue field. They never appear as solid UI colors, borders, or text.

rules.name: The Quiet Serif Rule
rules.body: The serif never goes bold and never shouts; authority comes from size and space, not weight.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the element floats above a panel (hero card, hover, sticky nav). Nothing at rest inside the page column carries one.

dos: Do keep every colored surface inset and rounded (The Inset Rule); the white ground breathes between panels.
Do set statements in Source Serif 4 at weight 400 to 500 and let size carry authority.
Do use pill buttons with uppercase labels and arrows for every action.
Do carry the Malaysian palette only as gradient glints inside blue fields (The Glint Rule).
Do write copy like a person: plain sentences, no em dashes, no slogan cadence.
donts: Don't run color bands edge to edge; the v1 full-bleed grammar is retired.
Don't use literal national imagery: no hibiscus, no flags, no patriotic motifs.
Don't bold the serif or use it for body text.
Don't use AI clichés: neon circuits, glowing brains, particle fields.
Don't put red or amber on UI chrome; they exist only inside the art.
